## Comments near the code
- BookingService.handlePaymentResult: Applies a PuckPay payment result. Idempotent; late payments do not revive released bookings.
- SessionService.effectiveCapacity: Capacity after club bookings: halved if one half is taken, zero if the whole rink is.
- ReportService.weekly: Report for the Monday-to-Sunday week containing `date`.
- ReportService.range: Report for an arbitrary inclusive date range (e.g. a whole season).
- IceMonitorService: Watches ice temperature and manages sessions put on hold because the ice is too warm.
- IceMonitorService.recordReading: Records a sensor reading; holds the next session once the ice has been warm for long enough.
- IceMonitorService.cancel: Manager cancels a held session: every paid ticket is refunded through PuckPay.
- IceMonitorService.release: Manager lifts the hold; ticket sales resume.
- IceMonitorService.warmLongEnough: True when the readings end in a run of warm readings spanning at least ten minutes.
- IceMonitorService.nextSession: The earliest session that has not started yet.

capabilities.description: Customers book skate tickets and hire skates for a session. The booking is checked against availability and the monthly free-skate allowance for members, then priced and paid through PuckPay checkout. Payment results are applied without double-processing, and unpaid bookings expire.
capabilities.name: Public skating ticket booking and payment

capabilities.description: Schedules rink sessions and works out how many tickets and how much hire equipment are still available. Capacity is reduced when clubs have booked half or all of the rink.
capabilities.name: Session scheduling and availability

capabilities.description: Clubs book half or all of the rink without overlapping other bookings. Their bookings are recorded and listed, and a monthly invoice is produced for each club.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and invoicing

capabilities.description: Produces reports of session sales and occupancy for a Monday-to-Sunday week or any date range (such as a season), with CSV export.
capabilities.name: Sales and occupancy reporting

capabilities.description: Watches ice temperature readings. If the ice stays too warm for long enough, the next session is put on hold and ticket holders are notified. A manager then either releases the hold so ticket sales resume, or cancels the session, which refunds every paid ticket.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session hold management

capabilities.description: Signals when a business rule is broken and sorts each failure into a status category, so callers can report it consistently.
capabilities.name: Business rule violation reporting
